product_launches.description: Remedy unveiled a trailer at The Game Awards for a new Control-related title called Control Resonant.

press_references.value: FBC: Firebreak Includes All These Changes For Launch, Including "Radically More Powerful" Weapons

product_launches.description: Remedy is officially launching FBC: Firebreak, a new game featuring significant changes based on player feedback, including more powerful weapons, overhauled combat intensity, dynamic tutorials, improved visual clarity, and enhanced audio. The game will be available on June 17 as a day-one title for Game Pass and PlayStation Plus, and can also be purchased for $40 on console and PC.

press_references.value: Remedy acknowledges bad first impression for FBC: Firebreak

product_launches.description: Remedy launched FBC: Firebreak, a Control spin-off game, but it received negative feedback due to poor onboarding, grindy missions, and uninteresting starting gear. Remedy is working on updates to address these issues.
Remedy launched its first self-published title, FBC: Firebreak, in June 2025, marking a significant step in its transition to self-publishing.

press_references.value: FBC: Firebreak Will Feature Cross-Play Multiplayer

product_launches.description: Remedy announced the launch of FBC: Firebreak, a multiplayer game with cross-play support, allowing players on PC, PS5, and Xbox Series X|S to play together. The game is a spin-off of Control and will be available on Xbox Game Pass and PS Plus.

overview_description.description:
Remedy provides an on-demand urgent and primary care service focusing on innovative delivery of care. Remedy delivers medical care in the form of 24/7 telemedicine and nurse access, lab visits, and house calls, for individual patients and large employer clients, enabling patients to get quality doorstep treatment at an affordable price.

Remedy was founded in 2015 and is based in Austin, Texas.
